title: Yellow Mellow Irish Fish Chowder
description: A creamy and comforting Irish fish chowder featuring a malty flavor and cheese-pull, perfect for a brunch mood, made with fish stock and emulsified for a plant-based friendly option.
instructions: In a large pot, melt the vegan butter over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, garlic, potato, carrot, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the fish stock, malted barley flour, and lemon juice to the pot, whisking continuously to emulsify.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes or until the soup has thickened slightly.
Stir in the plant-based cheese shreds until melted and well combined.
Season the chowder with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the Yellow Mellow Irish Fish Chowder hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
